notes: Three documents (CU APS 6012 responsible-use policy, Boulder CTL/BFA syllabus guidance draft, OIT AI data-security guidelines). Only-A units were all kept (principles, oversight, compliance duty, the tool-review criteria list, unit-guidance consistency, consequences advice, research summary example, scope statement). Only-B units: kept the human-judgment principle (P56), the definition of generative AI in the sample statement, and the impact-consideration duty; dropped the accessibility list item (merged into the A-only review-criteria list) and the 'uses and ramifications continue to evolve' rationale.
